extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos (lasting 300,000 hours) and 3,444,849 question-answering pairs (2 billion words of textual annotations) across five different task types: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Curated from four existing open-source video datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData, covering movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and in-the-wild videos. Dense event labels and timestamps were extracted and compiled from existing captions or via LLMs to construct instruction QA pairs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Consecutive short segments were filtered and regrouped into long video sequences (e.g., more than 60 seconds long from HD-VILA). For Ego4D, short video captions were concatenated into medium and long dense captions. For MiraData and HD-VILA, event and background labels were extracted using an LLM. Several types of long video QA pairs were generated and categorized into five tasks.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations and question-answering pairs were constructed based on existing video captions, event labels, and timestamps. Pre-existing captions (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo/HowToInterlink7M and HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and MiraData captions) were leveraged. For MiraData and HD-VILA, Qwen-72b was used to extract major events and background labels from captions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and instruction tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for long video understanding tasks, including video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
